The page's configurator shows '5 GB SSD' at RUB 252.5 per month, and the page's meta description states a floor of RUB 159.38 per month; no row at that floor was found on the page read. The page states unlimited traffic at up to 200 Mbit/s, weekly backups to a separate data centre, and a free WAF+ plan.
